verbatim: i like the moor folk - final. make salkt and silk folk the same species but different variant, so pull them slightly towards one another, then new sheet. pl9 - 4 is worht looking into more as a species, other can be cut. i like the pl10.1, ref sheet. made people should look more like raised from the dead, maybe they have no soul or a weak soul. remember the dominion will raise people up despite the cost. i didn't like the last two explorations

decisions.note: Moor folk final; accept the variation sheet as the visual reference without choosing an unrequested single individual.
Salt and silt folk are variants of one species; move their designs slightly toward each other and make a new sheet.
Develop selected crest design into a reference; not yet final.
Liked; preserve the tail-free coastal design in a reference sheet.
Made people should visibly look raised from death, informed by Dominion accepting the cost of diminished revival. No soul or weak soul is tentative.

unresolved: Whether the made people have no soul or a weak soul, their precise relationship to revival and earlier Imperial shaping, and their final appearance remain open. Do not keep an old whole-and-alive rule as an absolute ban on the new direction.
